results.name: The worker gets compact request counts on Bookings and mobile menu; reading does not clear requests
Participants and office accounts never inherit a worker request warning
Calendar displays server-time dates, overnight carry-over and exact existing booking controls
Month arithmetic crosses leap years and years without browser timezone drift
Day selection and arrow keys preserve focus and update the day agenda without a page jump
Month/week, date picker and Today controls request the intended date range
Cancelled visits are optional and toggling their display is read-only
Badge refresh is visible-page only, throttled and updated after booking actions
Late badge responses cannot leak into a new account or undo a more recent count
Late calendar reads cannot overwrite another page or a different client
Calendar failures and timeouts offer retry; a stale timeout response cannot overwrite recovery
Calendar strings are escaped and the selected day survives opening a booking and returning
Following the request notice refreshes even when it already points to the current calendar URL
